card.name: Intranasal vaccine wording; handheld objects
card.fires_on: The ending "al" in "intranasal" before influenza vaccine or corticosteroid terms in drug interaction text. Also weaker on everyday device or tool nouns such as remote, keyboard or straw.

modes.label: Intranasal ending
modes.description: The final piece of "intranasal" in live vaccine and nasal steroid warnings.
modes.example: The concurrent use of RELENZA with live attenuated influenza vaccine (LAIV) intranas<<al>> has not been evaluated.

modes.label: Everyday object nouns
modes.description: A device or tool noun after "my", "virtual" or "provided".
modes.example: After a little playing with my<< remote>> I managed to switch the subtitles on.
